newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal steady, some deposit rates dip.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal steady, some deposit rates dip.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal against the dollar was steady this week while some riyal interbank deposit rates dipped around 1/16 in lacklustre trade, dealers said.
"The spot riyal was unchanged in the week. The market was very quiet," one dealer said.
The spot Saudi riyal was quoted at 3.7504/06 to the dollar.

One-month interbank deposit rates were steady at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent. Three months were unchanged at 5-5/8, 1/2 percent. Six months were 1/16 lower at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent and one-year deposits were put at 5 7/8, 6/8 percent.
